description: Revert to the most aggressive stable configuration (Depth=8, Matrix LR=0.06, WD=0.1, Batch=128) which has consistently achieved the best val_bpb (~0.9904-0.9905) across multiple runs, as recent conservative attempts (0.055 LR / 0.12 WD) yielded slightly worse results, indicating the model requires faster updates to fully converge within the 5-minute budget.
